body:
Deliberately flat 'Cubes (N)' list in the side-pane, click-to-select reusing the existing setSelected/setSelectedSpawnPoint(null) pattern. New optional Wall.name field (Go+frontend), safe to ride along in ExportDoc.Walls since the native JSON scanner ignores unknown keys. go build/test + tsc/vite clean, deployed, verified in dist/ and binary. IDUNA 4e3f377.

⚓ ☃
title: Basic flat cubes/layers list in NOCK level editor (S490)
